disposition_reason: Tables 1.1 to 6 print per-sample and mean lead, cadmium and chromium in branded and unbranded cow milk from Kaduna.

study.design: market survey of unbranded raw cow milk (8 markets x 3 replicate samples) and branded supermarket cow milk
study.origin: unbranded milk from milk markets in Kaduna metropolis; branded milk origin not stated
study.market: Kaduna metropolis, Nigeria: Panteka, Railway, Rido, Kasuwar Barchi, Zango Cattle Market, Kajuru, Abubakar Gummi, Kasuwar Magani markets; supermarkets for branded milk
study.method: wet digestion (HCl/HClO4) of 1 cm3 milk, flame AAS
study.qa: reagent blanks and triplicate digestion; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Methods and abstract say 15 brands of branded milk, and Figures 3 and 5 show 15 brands (A-O), but Tables 1.1, 3 and 5 print only 5 brands; the remaining brand values are figure-only and were not extracted.
Abstract means (Cd, Pb, Cr 0.0014, 0.0017, 0.0028 ppm UCM; 0.0017, 0.0015, 0.0015 ppm BCM) are not printed in any table and do not match the table means; not recorded as findings.
Text says BCM lead means range 0.0009-0.0014 ppm with highest from brand 5, but Table 1.1 shows brand 4 at 0.001933 ppm.

Text says one unbranded sample (X-U, Kasuwar Magani) had Cd above limit, yet the stated Nigerian limit is 0.2 ppm and the highest printed value is 0.0055 ppm (Railway sample 2 prints 0.007 ppm); the exceedance cannot be reconciled.
Fat level and heat treatment of branded milk not stated; no LOD or collection dates reported.
